verifiedSource.preflight: build_moon.py lines61-78 validates and stores both entry slices before its first generated write at108. Missing/duplicate boot/native/body boundaries, including offline-only errors, cannot reach that write. end<=bodyend correctly allows native closing script immediately before body close.
verifiedSource.atomicityLimit: This closes the new Moon relocation boundary-failure defect. It is not a claim that the entire build_native pipeline or arbitrary I/O failure is an all-or-nothing filesystem transaction.

bodyComparison.result: All script bodies and their relative order are byte-identical to r15 except the exact first-paint documentation comment replacement (+5 body bytes) and its data-sha256. No executable producer/body change.

verifiedSource.neutralUI: Card and settings markup precede config/preview/Moon/native scripts in both forms. No timer, new readiness origin, whole-card hide or new producer is added. Markup existence does not mean event handlers are usable before native initialization, and cached/inline parsing offers no guaranteed paint opportunity.

controls.independentExecution: 8 synthetic Moon transaction tests PASS in0.478s; generated-entry test PASS for both r16 entries in0.837s. All fixtures/logs written only inside independent-review/parser-order-r48-controls.
controls.limit: Synthetic transaction tests intentionally mock receiver codec/native owner/source custody; their pass is not numerical or source-lineage qualification. Actual pins and unchanged relevant owners were separately read. Prior RED/failed-r47 retained.

findings.detail: Both entries preflight before Moon outputs; invalid offline entry cannot follow a partially changed index.

next() selects the first matching marker but does not reject later duplicate preview/Moon/refinement scripts. Config-before-preview is checked, not adjacency. The exact r16 outputs independently have one original sequence; recommend explicit cardinality and config adjacency controls.

An initial job failing currentness immediately retires its CSS background and its four legacy-layer withdrawal rules before the replacement solar-mask decode completes. The replacement canvas stays hidden and preview-ready absent until lines58-78 commit. nativeIdentity includes weather/elevation; the head always captured weather:null, while a cached native weather record can be accepted at boot. This supplies a concrete competing-publication path for the intact dark-disc/broad-wash source frame, but the r48 run has no event log proving that was the actual path.
findings.constraint: Do not keep a stale head, relax nativeResultCurrent, hide the whole card or delay/reset acceptance to repair this. Do not call the original an acquisition artifact without evidence.

limits: These are source capture times, not exact monitor presentation. Receipt clocks do not become exact source wall clocks.
The41.0653ms sample spacing does not establish a greater-than80ms failure or the exact duration of the unwanted state. It also does not repair the observed wrong first composition.
HeadHandoff=true at later diagnostics concerns the Moon owner; it does not prove the initial background job remained current against cached native weather.
Cold/new-tab and continuous watches were not independently reclassified in this bounded review.

nextDiscriminator: ROOT proposed one disposable r16 diagnostic with bounded inert event records from existing locals: initial currentness mismatch and retirement reason/time, pending mask request, and accepted framebuffer publication. No layout/style reads or pre15s getter polling; exact original video and unchanged clock origins. This can distinguish retirement-before-replacement from still-installed CSS image decode or acquisition behavior. A joined delayed-mask source control should preserve mandatory stale-head withdrawal while exposing the replacement ownership gap.
remainingGates: All original timing failures,80ms/source continuity, callback-cost, actual-parent and preserved H1/V5/opacity/geometry/V1 requirements remain. No causal diagnosis here grants full S1 or merge credit.
